messages:
Anne (Support): FYI — ACME flagged a feature-level cost/observability ask. They want a console view that maps daily spend -> feature tags -> traces. Must be able to click a spike and see related traces/logs. Sales calls this P1 for renewal.
Priya (Sales): Quote from customer: 'We need feature-level spend so we can chargeback to biz units. If we don't get this before EOM we risk the renewal.' Renewal in ~6 weeks. :eyes:
Sam (PM): Quick clarifying Qs: 1) Which "feature" dimension — route, model, or customer tag? 2) Required retention for event-level traces? 3) CSV export required = yes/no? Also do we need cross-customer rollups?
Carlos (Eng): From infra side — rough scope: a) ingest customer-side tags (we already capture route/model) b) attribution pipeline to map tokens/requests to tags and daily cost aggregates c) dashboard + drilldown UI linking to traces d) CSV export endpoint. MVP could be daily aggregates + trace links (no raw event retention) — estimate 3 sprints. Full fidelity (event-level retain + tag editor + export) another 2 sprints.
Anne (Support): ACME specifically uses a "feature" tag sent as `x-feature` header. They expect 90 days of aggregate history in UI, event-level traces for 14 days. CSV export mandatory. Security: must be RBAC and only visible to org admins.
Sam (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal (MVP): 1) Dashboard surfaces per-feature daily token & compute cost for last 90 days; 2) Click a day/feature -> drill to list of traces (sampled) for that feature; 3) CSV export of aggregates; 4) Feature gated + RBAC. Does that align?
Carlos (Eng): That's doable. Tradeoffs: storing per-feature event-level traces for 14 days increases storage and query costs. Alternative: keep event-level for 7 days + on-demand trace sampling for older windows. Also will need schema update for tags and update to billing attribution job — small DB migrations.
Priya (Sales): Can we gate a canary to ACME org only while we iterate? They'd be fine with an early cut. Also need audit log for who downloaded CSVs (finance requirement).
Carlos (Eng): Feature flagging + per-org canary is straightforward. Audit logging for export downloads — add to scope for MVP. We'll need to coordinate with security for PII handling in traces (redaction rules).
TelemetryBot: New ticket created: CS-4532 (ACME feature cost + trace link). Linked: ENG-1261, PRODUCT-789.
Sam (PM): OK — I'll add this to product intake board as P1-customer-driven. Next steps: schedule 30m triage with eng + security + sales tomorrow. Carlos — can you bring a rough implementation plan? Priya/Anne — please attach the customer's screenshots/CSV examples here.
Anne (Support): Adding customer screenshots and sample CSV to the thread now. :white_check_mark:
Sam (PM): Thanks — will draft proposed scope/MVP and rollout plan after triage. If anyone has objections to the acceptance criteria above, call them out now.
